context: Reproduce with a DataSource whose table payload contains serialized string paths, then normalize at the earliest DataFusion adapter boundary using the shared path-normalization contract. Preserve directory-format detection and multi-shard behavior.
description: Seed Corpus workflow_dispatch run 30455422794 selected SSB only. Both DataFusion cells failed during load with AttributeError: str object has no attribute is_dir at DataFusion directory-format detection, while SSB generation completed. DataFusion custom load_tables wraps scalar values in a list but does not normalize string paths to Path before calling _detect_directory_format. The shared data-loading layer already has normalize_table_paths; establish the correct reuse boundary and cover the real SSB source shape.

preserves.behavior: Path inputs, multi-shard lists, and Delta or Iceberg directory detection remain behaviorally unchanged
adapter imports stay lazy and the fix adds no eager DataFusion dependency

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit -k "datafusion and (path or load)" -q
verifications.description: String paths reach DataFusion loading as Path objects

verifications.command: uv run -- benchbox run --platform datafusion --benchmark ssb --scale 0.01 --phases generate,load,power --compression zstd:9 --non-interactive
verifications.description: Tiny SSB DataFusion lifecycle gets past table loading
verifications.expected: exit 0 with a clean result bundle
